processing: All medical imagery is extracted from the cited thesis figures. Only cropping and aspect-preserving resizing are applied. New elements are limited to layout, backgrounds, one contribution statement per image and short panel labels. No invented scans, histology, attention maps, retouching or contrast changes. Model outputs are the existing thesis results, not newly generated images.
coordinates: PDF pages are 1-based; PDF crop boxes are in points. Xrefs identify embedded images; pixel boxes refer to their native dimensions. Boxes use left, top, right, bottom coordinates with the top-left as origin.
presentation: Each image has one contribution statement, without a question or an additional footer statement. All medical imagery and panel labels in pixels [0, 140, 900, 630] remain identical to commit ea88342. Histology emphasizes classification using the original Nissl section and PosDiffAE region prediction from Figure 3.5. Architecture flows remain separate HTML, with Modelling in each middle box.

architecture.note: The middle box summarizes attention-aligned conditional modelling, including clinical condition encoding/fusion and cross-attention alignment with decoder features; it is not a separate standalone network layer.
